env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env CGO_ENABLED=0
env GOEXPERIMENT=

cd co

# data.lgo carries generated JSON methods, so its companion wants the
# data_jsonv2 stem; data_jsonv2.lgo already owns that stem for its own
# Version function. Reservation must give the companion a free name
# instead of letting one output silently discard the other.
logos run .
stdout '^v1: \{"title":"hi"\} version 7$'
cp stdout $WORK/native.txt

logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
exists out/data.go
exists out/data_jsonv2.go
exists out/data_jsonv2_jsonv2.go

cd out
go build ./...
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt
go vet ./...
exec $GOROOT/bin/gofmt -l .
! stdout .
cd ..

-- co/go.mod --
module example.com/collide

go 1.27

-- co/main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	v := Data{Title: "hi"}
	buf, err := v.MarshalJSON()
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Println("marshal err:", err)
		return
	}
	fmt.Println("v1:", string(buf), "version", Version())
}

-- co/data.lgo --
package main

type Data struct {
	Title string `json:"title"`
}

-- co/data_jsonv2.lgo --
package main

func Version() int {
	return 7
}
